observed.pattern: Every case became route-invalid before the intended 8-versus-16 stability comparison. The first invalid level varied by case, but the finest 8- and 16-substep levels were invalid for all 36 cases.

basis: The explicit Reference solver returns RETRY_ADVISED when HeadCalc requests timestep reduction; P2E18 treated that as route invalid.
HeadCalc applies CritDevBalCp and CritDevBalTot to residual rates. The residual includes storage change divided by dt, so the convergence quantities are in depth/time.
P2E18 held the rate tolerances fixed at 1e-12 cm/day while decreasing substep duration from 0.0016 to 0.0001 day.
Therefore the implied integrated balance convergence scale dt*CritDevBal shrank from 1.6e-15 cm to 1.0e-16 cm across the ladder, approaching floating-point summation resolution.
Because the intended 8-versus-16 endpoint comparison was never reached, 0/36 must not be interpreted as a failed REF-HIGH stability result.
adjudication.note: The test stub initializes global fldtmin false; the explicit adapter resets worker attempt control, and the observed failures arise as solve-level retry advice rather than a prerequest legacy-min-dt rejection.

next_permitted_action: Run a separate Reference-only diagnostic with a preregistered timestep-invariant integrated-balance convergence scale. Do not modify P2E18 post hoc and do not start RossFast timing.
